compression_level.description: Set the zlib compression level (0-9). Zero indicates no compression, nine indicates maximum compression.

quiet.description: Quiet mode; suppresses several warning messages.

verbose.description: Verbose mode; prints a bit of extra information.

noverify.description: No verify; turns off MD5 checksum verification of input and output files.

maxmem.description: Set an upper bound on the size of an in-memory page cache (e.g., 32M).

block_size.description: Set the block size for delta computation. Should be a power of 2. 0 uses default.

pristine.description: Disable automatic decompression of gzipped inputs to prevent recompression mismatches.
